culture.text: About 96 staff, based in Amsterdam, founded in 2018.
Many staff come from Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, TU Delft, UvA and VU, mostly in economics, business and marketing.
Builds filtered, flavoured drink systems for workplaces and says its team is its biggest asset.

growth.text: SportCity chose Aquablu for drinks across its clubs in the Netherlands, moving Aquablu from offices into gyms.
The deal covers more than 120 SportCity clubs.
